notes.title: Astro Prospector - Patch #1 Changelog
notes.content: [p]Hey there, Space Rebels! 🫡[/p][p]We have [b]released the first patch for Astro Prospector[/b]. This one is focused on some [i]small balance tweaks & bugfixing[/i], keeping the game challenging while accesible, and [i]adding some QoL features[/i], so your journey to obliterate SpaceCorp is smoother than ever! ✊[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]All no hit achievement has become no life lost achievement. Due to the amount of enemies in last zone, we decided it was more fair for the players to use their shield and dodge upgrades in order to clear this achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce Sector 3 Zone 2 difficulty. Roots spawn less frequently, and stay alive for less time. Followers shooters (homing bullets) appear more distributed within the progress of the zone. We know this zone was one of the hardest one, and we want to keep the challenge but make it less frustrating[/p][/*][*][p]More collection radius for both early game and late game. Slurp all those AstroCoffee seeds![/p][/*][*][p]Bullets trails are more visible when bullet speed is reduced. In the last version, bullets trails disappeared when buying slow-down bullet speed upgrades, now trails are visible no matter what[/p][/*][*][p]Some small reworking on Sector 3 & 4 visuals, so it should be cleaner and easier to read when there are a lot of things on screen[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Support for up to 4K resolution[/p][/*][*][p]Include upgrade tree zoom with Q/E in the upgrades screen[/p][/*][*][p]Not collecting data for balancing anymore![/p][/*][*][p]Include new setting for confining or not the cursor inside the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Include new setting for preventing the game to run if it’s minimized/no focused[/p][/*][*][p]Hide player UI when ship is in top-left corner[/p][/*][*][p]Controls panel for Keyboard, Mouse and Controller[/p][/*][*][p]End panel when completing the game, showing time to complete game, hits received and runs losing all lifes, with some small text lore message.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Cursor is shown again when finishing the Credits screen with Lock mouse option enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Heartbeat on 5-5 boss is stopped when going back to upgrades screen[/p][/*][*][p]Don’t get randomly hit when destroying the Cofferoid in 5-5[/p][/*][*][p]Check all achievements on game start, to unlock those that weren’t unlocked when it was supposed to[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuild UI when changing language mid-game, so everything stays on place after the change[/p][/*][*][p]Backup system for save files. In case any of your save files get corrupted, we’re automatically saving a backup to try to read the information from that file and recover your game![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s all for now! [b]We will keep listening to your opinions[/b]. We are now starting to work on the new content patch that will be releasing in September/October! 🥳[/p][p][/p][p]See you, Space Rebel ☕[/p]

notes.title: +15.000 Copies Sold + Astro Prospector Update Roadmap!
notes.content: [p]Hi, Rebels! 🫡[/p][p][/p][p]It has been 3 days since we launched Astro Prospector and... wow! Your welcoming has exceed our biggest expectations. [b]+15.000 copies sold in just 3 days [/b]is crazy! Thanks A LOT for your interest and for enjoying Astro Prospector that much ☕[/p][p][/p][p]We also want to let you know about [b]Astro Prospector roadmap[/b]. It's focused on 2 big blocks![/p][olist][*][p][i]🐛 Quality of Life & Bugfixing: [/i]we will start working on a first patch focused on [b]fixing all the glitchs and errors[/b] you have reported during this days. Also, we want to add some [b]new settings[/b], more resolutions support (2K & 4K) and improve some harsh edges of the game. You can expect this patch around the end of July![/p][/*][*][p][i]🤸‍♀️ New Game Modes[/i]: we have heard you and our priority after bugfixing will be including some [b]new game modes for Astro Prospector[/b]. Maybe an endless mode? A roguelite mode? Boss rush? New Game+? There are lots of cool ideas that we want to implement, and will try to choose the best of them. Our idea is to let you enjoy the game all the time you want, so we [b]will to[/b] [b]focus on open-ended modes that allows for high replayability[/b]! You can expect this patch around September/October. [/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]Of course, all patches and new modes will be included as [b]free updates[/b] 😊[/p][p]Thanks again for all your love. We hope you continue enjoying Astro Prospector for a long time! 🥰[/p][p][/p][p]Have a good day, and remember... F*ck SpaceCorp! ✊[/p]
